description: The bar chart, titled "Recall@10," presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different components in a conversation recommendation system. The horizontal axis displays four categories: "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking," representing the full model and its components when each is removed. The vertical axis, labeled "Recall@10," measures the model's performance on a scale from 0.1 to 0.4. The bar for "Ours" is the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 0.36. The bar for "- critiquing" is the second tallest, with a value of about 0.31. The bar for "- ranking" is slightly shorter, at approximately 0.25. The bar for "- scoring" is the shortest, with a value of about 0.18. The chart illustrates that removing the critiquing component has the smallest impact on performance, while removing the scoring component has the largest impact.
